day_titles.6: To Paro: Paro and Kyichu Lhakhang
day_titles.7: Ta dzong and rinpung dzong and tiger's nest hike

1: Arrival at Bagdogra or Siliguri and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
4: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
5: Breakfast in the warm Punakha valley
Gangtey Goemba on its low ridge
The crane valley spread out below
6: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
A guided round of the Paro valley
Kyichu Lhakhang, among the oldest temples in Bhutan
7: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The round watchtower holding the National Museum
Rinpung Dzong on the slope above the river
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
8: Breakfast, then the long run back south
Down through the Chukha gorge to the plains
Zangto Pelri Lhakhang in the town centre
The Bhutan Gate and the Torsa riverside
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: Our fullest western circuit in four star hotels, with the Gangtey day and a Phuentsholing tour on the way out.
expert.tip: The last day includes a Phuentsholing tour, so you are not just sitting at the border. Zangto Pelri is worth the half hour.

summary: 9 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 8 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing with simtokha dzong, the punakha sightseeing tour, the gangtey and the phobjikha valley, the paro sightseeing with kyichu lhakhang.
included: Included: 8 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing with Simtokha Dzong; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Gangtey and the Phobjikha valley; the Paro sightseeing with Kyichu Lhakhang; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; the Phuentsholing sightseeing tour; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
